title: Hillary Clinton tells Kimmel she'll get to the bottom of UFOs

tellings.quote: and and and then he asked her the question and that's when she says, "I'm going to get to the bottom of this."

plain: In 2016, on Jimmy Kimmel's late-night show in Los Angeles, Kimmel asked Hillary Clinton about UFOs and she answered, "I'm going to get to the bottom of this." A UFO researcher named Grant Cameron tells the story to Michels from memory, without naming a source, as a moment when a presidential candidate promised in public to look into the question.
